title: Practice 8: с-: down, and together — раз-: apart

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Дом один все за всех знает: он ___ (расползаться — to crawl away).
exercises.why: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "**с**": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "**-ся**" the verb **встречать** — **встретить** is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.* We already know that the verbs in "**-ся**" may be divided into several groups. Verbs which never occur without the ending "**-ся**": *Я боюсь вашего брата.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 66–67.  ·  From Юрий Тынянов, «Смерть Вазир-Мухтара».
exercises.context: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "**с**": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "**-ся**" the verb **встречать** — **встретить** is used with the direct object in the Accusative…

exercises.q: К школе ___ (сбежаться / сбегаться — to come running) вся станица.
exercises.why: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat.. **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)** — Divergent movement in various directions from one center. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Хождение по мукам».
exercises.context: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat..

exercises.q: ___ (снести / сносить — to carry down), того-этого, за ноги тащит!
exercises.why: **снести́** — **сноси́ть** — to carry down; to carry to. **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Леонид Андреев, «Сашка Жегулёв».
exercises.context: снести́** — **сноси́ть — to carry down; to carry to.

exercises.q: Уженье просто ___ (свести / сводить — to lead, to take) меня с ума!
exercises.why: **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. **сойти́сь** — **сходи́ться** — to meet, to come together; to converge, to coalesce. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Сергей Аксаков, «Детские годы Багрова-внука».
exercises.context: свести́** — **своди́ть — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together.

exercises.q: И ___ (слететь / слетать — to fly down, to fly away) опять во двор.
exercises.why: **слете́ть** — **слета́ть** — to fly down (from), to fly away (from); (colloquial) to fall down (from), to fall (off). **сбежа́ть** — **сбега́ть** — to run down (from); to run away, to make off, to flee, to break out. **снести́** — **сноси́ть** — to carry down; to carry to. **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Юрий Тынянов, «Смерть Вазир-Мухтара».
exercises.context: слете́ть** — **слета́ть — to fly down (from), to fly away (from); (colloquial) to fall down (from), to fall (off).

exercises.why: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat.. **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)** — Divergent movement in various directions from one center. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Максим Горький, «Жизнь Клима Самгина».

exercises.q: Оно ___ (сползти / сползать — to slip down, to work down) с костей.
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Всеволод Гаршин, «Четыре дня».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: В город ___ (свезти / свозить — to transport, to drive, to convey).
exercises.why: **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. **сойти́сь** — **сходи́ться** — to meet, to come together; to converge, to coalesce. **съе́хаться** — **съезжа́ться** — to meet (on one's way); to assemble, to come together, to gather. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Викентий Вересаев, «В тупике».
exercises.context: свезти́** — **свози́ть — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back.

exercises.q: Уж мы лучше будем ___ (сходиться — to meet, to come together) здесь.
exercises.why: Он сходит вниз по лестнице. (b) to come off, to drive off: Автомобиль съехал с дороги. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Иван Тургенев, «Дым».
exercises.context: Он сходит вниз по лестнице.

exercises.q: Елена ___ (расходиться — to go away, to disperse, to spread) с мужем.
exercises.why: **разойти́сь** — **расходи́ться** — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread; to break up (of a crowd, meeting, etc.). **разъе́хаться** — **разъезжа́ться** — to depart, to leave; to disperse. **разлете́ться** — **разлета́ться** — to fly away, to scatter (in the air); to come apart, to be blown apart. **разбежа́ться** — **разбега́ться** — to scatter; to take a run, to run up (before jumping, diving, etc). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Михаил Булгаков, «Дни Турбиных».
exercises.context: разойти́сь** — **расходи́ться — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread; to break up (of a crowd, meeting, etc.).

exercises.q: И с твердостью ___ (снести / сносить — to carry down) боярский ропот.
exercises.why: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Александр Пушкин, «Борис Годунов».
exercises.context: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы.

exercises.context: разойти́сь** — **расходи́ться — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread; to break up (of a crowd, meeting, etc.).
